objective_contribution: Remove pre-treatment stochastic divergence so evidence-only ARE state can be judged causally for GLM-5.3-flash at 8K, preserving useful ContextBench quality and completed outcomes within cumulative model input plus output tokens.

question_and_hypotheses.question: When control and treatment continue from the same exact first-recycle boundary, does evidence-only ARE state improve useful native ContextBench selection and valid completion within cumulative model input plus output tokens?

measurement_mapping.native: Post-exposure paired native ContextBench span and file metrics measure evidence-selection usefulness; they do not prove patch correctness or general reasoning transfer.
measurement_mapping.retention: A verified prior delivery, actual first-recycle displacement and exact treatment presentation followed by independently scored subsequent evidence use support a useful-retention claim.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Verify the shared boundary digest, repository and evidence identity, receipt ancestry, isolated branch writes, zero control state, exact treatment exposure, source credit and terminal effects.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count cumulative model input and output tokens for the shared prefix and every successful, failed, corrective, treatment and control branch request; unknown usage makes a pair ineligible.
measurement_mapping.transfer: The causal fork is a reusable evaluator mechanism, but one exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K development study cannot establish larger-window, other-model, non-coding, correctness or confirmation claims.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: Finish the GLM small-window chapter before larger windows, other models, or other domains.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Rounds one through fourteen and the selected eight-task development cohort are exposed; all reserved confirmation identities remain untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No within-round tuning, state-content change, threshold change, task replacement, favorable-repetition selection or failed-branch replay. Stop a pair on ancestry, isolation, exposure or accounting mismatch.

retained_counterevidence: Round 14 completed all sixteen cells but only five of eight pairs had native scores in both arms.
Round 14 missed the state-token ceiling by 23,468 tokens and three recycled treatment generations lacked a state presentation.
Round 14 independent arms had different first responses in every pair, so their pre-treatment trajectories were not controlled.
Round 14 task 4 arms differed even though treatment had no recycle and no state exposure.
Round 14 descriptive +0.1084769 paired span F1 and 107,942-token state saving cannot establish a causal state benefit.
Native evidence selection remains distinct from semantic retention, repair correctness, completed user outcomes and transfer.
successor_rule: Build and validate the fork without model calls, then freeze and run H25 once under its repeated-branch protocol. If H25 fails, review H20 and H0 from all retained results. If it passes, prepare the fixed 8K clearance design; every successor must again carry all three objective levels, the exact method and predecessor counterevidence.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: The plan tests a reusable causal evaluator for ARE continuity, quality, completion and cumulative model-token efficiency.
criterion_verdicts.initial_GLM_objective: The plan explicitly keeps GLM-5.3-flash at the 8K small-window-first milestone.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: The fixed ContextBench contract remains unchanged and uncleared; Round 15 development cannot claim clearance.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: The exact research chain starts from reviewed Round 14 causal counterevidence and selects H25 against H20 and H0.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: Incomplete native pairs, missed state exposure/token gates and pre-treatment divergence are retained.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Native quality, retention exposure, integrity, transfer limits and every model input/output token are mapped separately.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: The exposed 8K causal study precedes fixed full-dataset and reserved confirmation; no SWE-bench stage or larger-window claim is added.
criterion_verdicts.testability: The offline oracle requires exact ancestry and an isolated one-request state difference before any live dispatch.
